stepNotes.1: Scoped to one Hono router (PermissionRoutes, permission.ts:10) mounted at /permission by server.ts:314; two endpoints POST /:requestID/reply and GET /.
stepNotes.2: Mutating surface is the reply POST; requestID is a branded PermissionID (schema.ts:3) and reply is a strict enum once|always|reject (permission/index.ts:70), both enforced by hono-openapi validators before the handler runs.
stepNotes.3: Reply handler checks the boolean returned by Permission.reply (permission.ts:39-47) and surfaces 404 PermissionUnavailableError on false; the #341 comment explains why a pre-call pending check would race.
stepNotes.4: No shared state owned by the route; pending map, per-instance alwaysReplyQueue mutex, and cross-process FileLock (permission/index.ts:475) all live in the Permission module and are correctly delegated.
stepNotes.5: GET / is effectively constant-time (listPromise is an Array.from over the in-memory map, permission/index.ts:531-534); POST pays the file-lock + DB transaction cost only for always replies, owned by the module not the route.
stepNotes.6: operationIds permission.reply and permission.list are unique; POST documents 200/400/404 via errors(400,404); GET documents only 200 (minor asymmetry, LOW). Sibling duplication of the same envelope at session-impl.ts:1562-1582 is intentional.
stepNotes.7: No dead code; all eight imports (Hono, describeRoute, resolver, validator, z, Permission, errors/notFound, lazy, route-params helpers) are used; zero empty catches, zero TODOs.
stepNotes.8: Stale-request 404 path is directly tested in route-validation.test.ts:594-625 against the exact envelope shape; happy paths and Permission.list are covered transitively via next.test.ts and acp/event-subscription.test.ts; gap: no HTTP-layer GET / serialization assertion.
stepNotes.9: No Critical/High/Medium findings; two LOW notes only (uncapped message string at permission.ts:31, missing 5xx envelope in GET / OpenAPI). No reverify.md required.
